title: 第二章：猎杀者
content_zh:
‘猎杀者’，这神秘的‘轮回乐园’，从一开始就这样称呼苏晓。
这个称呼，让苏晓感觉很奇怪，他并没有签订那所谓的契约。
“猎杀者这个称呼代表了什么。”
苏晓的这个问题，让‘轮回乐园’出现巨大的反应。
【普通人在签订契约后，将成为契约者，为‘乐园’执行任务，乐园给予奖励。】
【所谓猎杀者，是一些天赋特殊的契约者，这些契约者的天赋更加适合战斗。】
【猎杀者在执行普通任务的同时，‘乐园’将会同时发布猎杀任务，清理那些‘异常’的契约者。】
【询问次数耗尽，‘乐园’不再回答猎杀者任何问题，请签订契约或等待死亡。】
所有光芒消退，四周变得漆黑一片。
一张模样古朴的羊皮纸，在虚空中弹出，垂在半空。
苏晓费力的站起身，走到羊皮纸前。
羊皮纸上满是奇怪的符号，在最下方位置，是大片的空白。
【是/否签订契约。】
苏晓隐约感觉，如果他同意签订这份契约，他的人生将会发生翻天覆地的改变。
他有太多事要做，就算前方是万丈深渊，他也只能纵身跃下。
“我~，同意。”
苏晓的话音刚落，手就不受控制的抬起，之后拇指按向羊皮纸的空白处。
刺痛在指尖传来，一抹鲜红的血迹将羊皮纸侵染，之后整张羊皮纸都变成淡红色。
【契约成立！开始恢复猎杀者伤势。】
淡绿色光点在苏晓周围出现，攀附在他身体上，短短几秒钟的时间，他的伤势就彻底恢复。

【伤势恢复完成，强制觉醒猎杀者天赋。】
身体才恢复正常，还没等苏晓松口气，一阵剧痛在身体各处传来。
剧痛来的非常突然，让苏晓身体各处的血管全部暴起。
但苏晓的忍耐力超乎常人，只是发出一声闷哼，单膝跪倒在地。
剧痛来的突然，消退的也很快，苏晓察觉到，他体内仿佛有某种东西被唤醒。
那种感觉并不唐突，就好像他本身就有这种能力，但却一直没能察觉。
【为了直观表现‘猎杀者’的综合素质，半数据化开启。】
【警告；‘半数据化’为辅助战斗能力，心脏、大脑等重要组织严重受损，猎杀者依然会死亡。】
【猎杀者专属试炼开始，如无法完成试炼，‘乐园’将剥离猎杀者身份，成为普通契约者，如在任务中死亡，猎杀者将会彻底死亡。】
【乐园条例：一切都将等价交换，】
苏晓刚完那些文字，就感觉眼前一黑，之后失去知觉。
【传送开始……】
----------------------
当苏晓再次醒来时，已经身处一间破烂的房间中。
房间只有十几平米大小，屋顶已经是半坍塌状，阳光直射而入。
墙角处有大量蛛网，蛛网上已经布满灰尘，窗户与门已经不翼而飞，但四周没有丝毫的光线透入，只能看到大片的垃圾，一些垃圾已经通过门窗涌入到房间中。
这间破烂的房间，应该是被掩埋在一座大型垃圾堆中，只有屋顶是出口。
刺鼻的味道传来，就在苏晓准备离开这里时，手臂上传来一阵灼烧感。
一把利剑模样的黑色纹身，出现在他的小臂上。
那种淡蓝色文字再次浮现，

但这次并不是漂浮在空气中，而是直接出现在他的视线内，就算视角调转，那些文字也一动不动，仿佛镶嵌在他的视网膜上一般。
文字的内容如下：
进入世界；海贼王
世界难度：lv.6。炼狱（此难度为猎杀着试炼难度）
世界之源；0%（猎杀者探索或与当前世界人物交流，将会增长，在结算世界时，与任务难度互相计算，形成最终评分）
世界简介；大海，自由，海贼，海军，世界政府。
主线任务；刺杀‘哥亚王国’国王。
支线任务；无。
警告：请勿在本世界提及‘乐园’的一切，如警告无效，将强制处决！
提示：本世界为高等‘衍生世界’，请勿离开‘哥亚王国’区域，否则世界难度将大幅度提升！
提示：因猎杀者初次进入世界，本世界语言猎杀者自动掌握，期限（三个自然日）
世界，开始！
文字隐去，苏晓开始梳理他了解到的信息。
首先，他来到了一处很神秘的地方，这里名为‘轮回乐园’，‘轮回乐园’的目的他不得而知，但他的目的很明确，那就是在‘轮回乐园’中得到力量，有了力量才能复仇。
其次就是他现在的处境，他居然来到了‘海贼王’世界。
他虽然要复仇，但在闲暇之余，他会看一些动漫放松一些心情，人不能总是紧绷。
以苏晓对海贼世界的了解，这里是一个高危世界，到了后期，那些强者甚至能打沉一座岛，或独自屠灭一个国家，
虽然精通一些杀人技巧，但苏晓完全是一个普通人，到了这种满是非人怪物的世界，可谓是举步维艰。
从世界难度的‘地狱’两字，就能看出这个世界的难度。
至于最后给出的任务，苏晓更是不明所以。

【刺杀‘哥亚王国’国王】，就这简单的几个字，没有其他线索。
就在苏晓有些头疼时，一股信息从手臂上那利剑模样的纹身内传来。
他可以用意识激活‘烙印’，所谓烙印，就是他手臂上那利剑模样的纹身。
这东西很重要，有许多功能。
苏晓尝试激活烙印，很简单就做到，眼前浮现几行文字。
一，个人信息。
二，任务
三，储蓄空间。
四，技能。
五，装备。
阶位过低，其他功能未解锁……。
苏晓现在除了第一项（个人信息）和第二项（任务)外，其他暂时用不到。
他迫切的想知道，任务的具体内容，从之前‘轮回乐园’变现出的态度来看，绝不会容忍任务失败，一般失败，可能就是死路一条。
什么降为普通契约者，应该根本没有那种可能，虽然只是短暂接触，但苏晓敏感察觉到‘轮回乐园’的残酷。
【主线任务：刺杀‘哥亚王国’国王】
难度等级：lv.3。
任务简介：‘哥亚王国’地处东海，统治着附近的城镇与村庄，周边坐落着‘风车镇’以及‘科尔波山’。
任务信息：用任意方法杀掉‘哥亚王国’国王，‘菲利普?赫伯特’，对方常年身处王宫内，刺杀难度较高。
任务期限：七十二小时内。
任务奖励：猎杀者身份完全激活。

看到以上信息，苏晓终于明白他要杀谁，以及身处的位置。
难怪四周这么多垃圾，他现在所处的位置，是在‘哥亚王国’附近的‘废品终点站’，在原著中那座因为天龙人的到来，被焚烧的垃圾山。
原著中的主角蒙奇?d?路飞，以及重要的角色艾斯、萨博，就是在科尔波山长大，山上还生活着一群山贼。
而‘哥亚王国’的首都，就在‘科尔波山’附近，紧挨着他所在的‘废品终点站’。
四周这些垃圾，就是‘哥亚王国’的首都所产生。
想到这些，苏晓反而不着急离开，‘废品终点站’游荡着大量流民，非常危险，他还是先了解情况后，再做打算。
将任务面板关闭，苏晓
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
‘Hunter’, this mysterious ‘Reincarnation Paradise’, was what Su Xiao had been called from the beginning.
This title made Su Xiao feel very strange. He did not sign the so-called contract.
"What does the title Hunter mean?"
Su Xiao's question caused a huge reaction in the 'Reincarnation Paradise'.
[After ordinary people sign a contract, they will become contractors and perform tasks for the Paradise, and the Paradise will reward them. 】
[The so-called hunters are contractors with special talents. The talents of these contractors are more suitable for fighting. 】
[While hunters are performing ordinary tasks, ‘Paradise’ will issue hunting tasks at the same time to clean up those ‘abnormal’ contractors. 】
[The number of inquiries has been exhausted, and ‘Paradise’ will no longer answer any questions from the hunter. Please sign a contract or wait for death. 】
All the light faded and everything became pitch black.
A piece of parchment with a simple appearance popped up in the void and hung in the air.
Su Xiao stood up with difficulty and walked to the parchment.
The parchment is full of strange symbols, and at the bottom there is a large blank space.
[Y/N signed the contract. 】
Su Xiao vaguely felt that if he agreed to sign this contract, his life would change dramatically.
He had too many things to do. Even if there was an abyss ahead of him, he could only jump down.
"I~, agree."
As soon as Su Xiao finished speaking, she raised her hand uncontrollably, and then pressed her thumb to the blank space of the parchment.
A stinging pain came from the fingertips, and a bright red stain stained the parchment, and then the entire parchment turned light red.
[The contract is established! Start recovering the hunter's injuries. 】
Light green light spots appeared around Su Xiao and clung to his body. In just a few seconds, his injuries completely recovered.
[Injury recovery completed, forced awakening of hunter talent. 】
His body had just returned to normal, but before Su Xiao could breathe a sigh of relief, a sharp pain spread throughout his body.
The severe pain came very suddenly, causing all the blood vessels in Su Xiao's body to bulge.
But Su Xiao's endurance was beyond ordinary people, so she just groaned and fell to the ground on one knee.
The severe pain came suddenly and subsided quickly. Su Xiao noticed that something seemed to be awakened in his body.
The feeling was not abrupt, as if he had this ability himself but had never been able to notice it.
[In order to intuitively express the comprehensive quality of the ‘Hunter’, semi-digitalization is enabled. 】
[Warning: ‘Semi-digitalization’ is an auxiliary combat capability. Important tissues such as the heart and brain are severely damaged, and the hunter will still die. 】
[The hunter’s exclusive trial begins. If the trial cannot be completed, ‘Paradise’ will strip off the identity of the hunter and become an ordinary contractor. If he dies during the mission, the hunter will die completely. 】
[Paradise Regulations: Everything will be exchanged of equal value,]
As soon as Su Xiao finished those words, her vision went dark and she lost consciousness.
[Transmission begins...]
-----------------------
When Su Xiao woke up again, she was already in a dilapidated room.
The room was only a dozen square meters in size, and the roof was half-collapsed, allowing direct sunlight to enter.
There are a large number of cobwebs in the corners of the wall. The cobwebs are already covered with dust. The windows and doors have disappeared, but no light penetrates from the surroundings. Only large areas of garbage can be seen. Some garbage has poured into the room through the doors and windows.
This dilapidated room should be buried in a large garbage dump, with only the roof being the exit.
The pungent smell came, and just when Su Xiao was about to leave here, there was a burning sensation on her arm.
A black tattoo that looked like a sword appeared on his forearm.
The light blue text appeared again,
But this time it was not floating in the air, but appeared directly in his sight. Even if the perspective was changed, the words remained motionless, as if they were embedded in his eyes.Normal on the retina.
The content of the text is as follows:
Enter the world; One Piece
World difficulty: lv.6. Purgatory (this difficulty is the hunter trial difficulty)
The source of the world; 0% (when hunters explore or communicate with characters in the current world, it will increase. When settling the world, it will be calculated with the task difficulty to form the final score)
Introduction to the world; sea, freedom, pirates, navy, world government.
Main mission: assassinate the king of the ‘Kingdom of Goa’.
Side quests; none.
Warning: Please do not mention anything about "Paradise" in this world. If the warning is invalid, you will be forcibly executed!
Tip: This world is an advanced 'derivative world', please do not leave the 'Kingdom of Goa' area, otherwise the difficulty of the world will be greatly increased!
Tip: Because the Hunter enters the world for the first time, the Hunter automatically masters the language of this world, and the period is (three natural days)
World, begin!
The text disappeared, and Su Xiao began to sort out the information he learned.
First, he came to a very mysterious place called the 'Reincarnation Paradise'. He didn't know the purpose of the 'Reincarnation Paradise', but his purpose was very clear, that is, to gain strength in the 'Reincarnation Paradise', and only with strength can he take revenge.
The second is his current situation. He actually came to the world of 'One Piece'.
Although he wants revenge, in his spare time, he will watch some anime to relax. People can't be tense all the time.
Based on Su Xiao's understanding of the pirate world, this is a high-risk world. In the later stages, those strong men can even sink an island or massacre a country alone.
Although he is proficient in some killing techniques, Su Xiao is completely an ordinary person. In a world full of inhuman monsters, it can be said that it is difficult to move forward.
The difficulty of this world can be seen from the word "hell" in the world difficulty.
As for the final task given, Su Xiao was even more unclear about it.
[Assassination of the King of the Kingdom of Goa], just these few words, there are no other clues.
Just when Su Xiao had a headache, a message came from the sword-like tattoo on her arm.
He can activate the 'brand' with his consciousness. The so-called brand is the sword-like tattoo on his arm.
This thing is important and has many functions.
Su Xiao tried to activate the brand, and it was easy. A few lines of text appeared in front of her eyes.
1. Personal information.
2. Task
Third, savings space.
Four, skills.
Five, equipment.
The level is too low and other functions are not unlocked...
Except for the first item (personal information) and the second item (task), Su Xiao can't use it for the time being.
He urgently wants to know the specific content of the mission. Judging from the attitude shown by the 'Reincarnation Paradise' before, mission failure will never be tolerated. Generally, failure may be a dead end.
It should be impossible to be reduced to an ordinary contractor. Although it was only a brief contact, Su Xiao was sensitive to the cruelty of the 'Reincarnation Paradise'.
[Main mission: Assassinate the king of the ‘Kingdom of Goa’]
Difficulty level: lv.3.
Mission introduction: The 'Kingdom of Goa' is located in the East China Sea and governs nearby towns and villages. It is surrounded by 'Windmill Town' and 'Corbo Mountain'.
Mission information: Use any method to kill the king of the Kingdom of Goa, Philip Herbert. The opponent is in the palace all year round, so it is difficult to assassinate him.
Mission deadline: within seventy-two hours.
Mission reward: Hunter identity fully activated.
After seeing the above information, Su Xiao finally understood who he wanted to kill and where he was.
No wonder there is so much garbage around. His current location is the "Scrap Terminal" near the "Kingdom of Goa". In the original work, the garbage mountain was burned due to the arrival of the Celestial Dragons.
The protagonist Monkey D. Luffy in the original work, as well as the important characters Ace and Sabo, grew up in Mount Korpo, where a group of bandits also lived.
And ‘King GoaThe capital of the country is located near Corpo Mountain, next to the Scrap Terminal where he is located.
The garbage around is produced by the capital of the Kingdom of Goa.
Thinking of this, Su Xiao was not in a hurry to leave. There were a large number of refugees wandering around the 'Scrap Terminal', which was very dangerous. He had better understand the situation first before making plans.
Close the task panel, Su Xiao
(Sanqi Chinese et)
